name: neodev-rd-knowledge
description: NeoSuperpower workflow plugin for local neodev CLI orchestration, version-branch navigation, controlled document import, DocChange verification, graph refresh, planning, TDD, debugging, browser acceptance testing, and completion verification.

interface.shortDescription: Run NeoSuperpower workflows for NeoDev CLI work, planning, browser acceptance testing, TDD, debugging, and verification.
interface.longDescription: Official NeoSuperpower workflow layer for NeoDev RD knowledge operations. It embeds the former Superpowers planning, test-first implementation, systematic debugging, code-review, delegation, and completion-verification skill bodies under NeoSuperpower skill names, plus strict browser acceptance testing. Product/version discovery, version-scoped document import, DocChange registration, graph impact analysis, branch graph refresh, and Git verification stay behind the configured local neodev CLI client.
capabilities: Browser acceptance testing with evidence artifacts
defaultPrompt: Use NeoSuperpower to plan and implement this change.
Use NeoSuperpower to debug this failure from evidence.
Use NeoDev to inspect this product version and branch context.
Use NeoDev to import the controlled docs for this version.
Use NeoDev to register the DocChange and estimate implementation impact.
Use NeoDev to refresh and verify the branch graph after push.
Use browser acceptance testing to validate this page with screenshots, network evidence, and a report.

neodev.contract: Remote-service CLI orchestration for Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. Local clients install/configure neodev and use the remote NeoDev service for facts and state changes; direct database access is diagnostic only.

third_party.name: Superpowers
third_party.integration: Skill bodies copied into this plugin and renamed with the neosuperpower- prefix.
